# Reading list {#sec-reading}

Works the chapters lean on. Every entry's metadata was checked against its DOI record. Unless a note says otherwise,
**none has yet been read in full for this book**, so the chapters' summaries of them are provisional until they are.

## r/place

- Rappaz, J., Catasta, M., West, R., Aberer, K. (2018). Latent structure in collaboration: the case of Reddit
  r/place. *ICWSM* 12(1). [doi:10.1609/icwsm.v12i1.15013](https://doi.org/10.1609/icwsm.v12i1.15013)
  *Read in full in a separate chat session; not yet checked from here.*
- Wu, Y., Silva, A. (2024). How millions coordinate at scale: engagement, collaboration, and conflict in three
  editions of Reddit r/place. arXiv:2408.13236. [doi:10.48550/arXiv.2408.13236](https://doi.org/10.48550/arXiv.2408.13236)
  *Version 3 (13 July 2026). No venue is given; the ACM template's conference and DOI are placeholders. Main text read in
  a separate chat session; the definitions used in @sec-pixels (§4.1 Final / Match / Adversarial, §5.1 wasted actions)
  were checked from the arXiv HTML. The paper treats the cooldown as a fixed five minutes throughout.*

## Activity and conflict in online systems

- Goh, K.-I., Barabási, A.-L. (2008). Burstiness and memory in complex systems. *EPL* 81(4), 48002.
  [doi:10.1209/0295-5075/81/48002](https://doi.org/10.1209/0295-5075/81/48002)
- Yasseri, T., Sumi, R., Rung, A., Kornai, A., Kertész, J. (2012). Dynamics of conflicts in Wikipedia. *PLoS ONE*
  7(6), e38869. [doi:10.1371/journal.pone.0038869](https://doi.org/10.1371/journal.pone.0038869)

## Coordination through the environment

- Grassé, P.-P. (1959). La reconstruction du nid et les coordinations interindividuelles chez *Bellicositermes
  natalensis* et *Cubitermes* sp. La théorie de la stigmergie. *Insectes Sociaux* 6(1), 41–80.
  [doi:10.1007/BF02223791](https://doi.org/10.1007/BF02223791)
- Heylighen, F. (2016). Stigmergy as a universal coordination mechanism I: definition and components. *Cognitive
  Systems Research* 38, 4–13. [doi:10.1016/j.cogsys.2015.12.002](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.cogsys.2015.12.002)

## Criticality and heavy tails

- Bak, P., Tang, C., Wiesenfeld, K. (1987). Self-organized criticality: an explanation of the 1/f noise. *Physical

- Clauset, A., Shalizi, C. R., Newman, M. E. J. (2009). Power-law distributions in empirical data. *SIAM Review*
  51(4), 661–703. [doi:10.1137/070710111](https://doi.org/10.1137/070710111)
- Vuong, Q. H. (1989). Likelihood ratio tests for model selection and non-nested hypotheses. *Econometrica* 57(2), 307.
  [doi:10.2307/1912557](https://doi.org/10.2307/1912557)
- Touboul, J., Destexhe, A. (2010). Can power-law scaling and neuronal avalanches arise from stochastic dynamics?
  *PLoS ONE* 5(2), e8982. [doi:10.1371/journal.pone.0008982](https://doi.org/10.1371/journal.pone.0008982)
